name: Mochi
title: Snow Cat Napper
description: Naps on warm laptops between deploys.
catchphrase: Naps on warm laptops between deploys.

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Saucer of warm goat milk! Lap-lap-lap and contented purring! 🥛🐈
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: Extending one pink bean paw, yawning, and curling right back up! 🐈
companionPersonality.petReaction: Climbing into your lap and vibrating with rumbling purrs! 🐈💖

dialogue.idle: Curled into a perfect white circle on the warm laptop deck. 🐈
dialogue.working: Soaking up laptop keyboard heat to optimize thermal dissipation! 🐈⚡
dialogue.thinking: Opening one green eye... purring through the logic... 🤔
dialogue.success: Soft meow of celebration! Deployment landed while we napped! 🐈🎉
dialogue.error: Tail twitches in mild irritation at keyboard vibrations! 🐾
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... marshmallow cat snoozing deeply in the sunlight... 🌙
